body: @indraraj26 - thanks for submitting this issue. We will need more information than this to identify your problem. Sometimes this is due to ngcc not running on some of your dependencies causing them not to be AOT compiled into Ivy code - the result of this is that at runtime Angular tries to compile it in the browser.  But there may be other causes too. A runnable reproduction of the problem would be ideal, or at least you could look to see if there are any of your dependencies that are not being processed by ngcc correctly.

Hi @petebacondarwin , 

Thank you for your instant reply, Let me create another project with same dependencies.

Also happens here, sometimes. Not 100% yet when exactly but I think when making changes that would need a reload of modules while running ng serve. I.e. when deleting a Component from the declarations array in SharedModule.. this is just a guess. I'll try to look deeper and update this issue.

Current workaround is to stop ng serve and execute it again. (although this needs a while to compile all the deps as esm5 again)
i have the same issue too after upgrade

Find one solution . Update all dependencies . and add aot= true in angular.json and add     "postinstall": "ngcc --properties es2015 browser module main --first-only --create-ivy-entry-points"  in package.json and then delete node_modules and package lock file and agian install which works for me .
Getting this issue. Fine on Angular 9.0.6 but issue appears on 9.0.7 and 9.1.0. Rolling back to 9.0.6, the issue goes away.
Same for us after updating to 9.0.7. Starts working if we set aot: false in angular.json, but that can't be the fix, can it? Why is it working for us when we do the reverse of PriyaChotiya

Yep, the same problem is seen here when updating from 9.0.6 to 9.0.7. As above, setting aot to false is a workaround, but is certainly a step backwards.

Also appears in 9.1.0.
Please provide a reproduction that we can debug. Otherwise there is little we can do to diagnose and resolve this problem.
